links.outcome: Readability (FRES, FKGL) of LLM answers to patient questions about meniscus injuries
links.effect: Both models produced comparable readability scores (p > 0.05), corresponding to a high-school reading level; no significant difference between ChatGPT-5 and DeepSeek R1.
links.quote: Both models produced comparable readability scores (p > 0.05), corresponding to a high-school reading level.

screen.reason: Empirical comparison of two LLMs (ChatGPT vs DeepSeek) answering patient questions on meniscus injuries evaluated by expert clinicians for readability and quality, without evaluating specific deployment safeguards or practices.
